item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00339","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C16","C21","C20"],"selected_candidate_label":"C16","confidence":0.98,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C16 plausibly supplied a concrete template for congratulating a newly installed Commonwealth prime minister: it praises the recipient's established career, predicts that his achievements will benefit his country and the wider world, and closes by wishing him success in his newly accepted responsibility. The child's sequence and several expressions closely track that model, adapted from Louis St. Laurent to Harold Macmillan. C21 and C20 share congratulatory diplomatic language and confidence in national leadership, but concern national commemorations rather than accession to office and are less structurally specific.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"I send my warmest congratulations to you on becoming Prime Minister of the United Kingdom.","parent_excerpt":"It is a great pleasure to congratulate you ... on your acceptance of the leadership of one of the world's great nations.","explanation":"Both open by congratulating a foreign statesman on assuming leadership of a major nation."},{"child_excerpt":"Your distinguished career is well known on this side of the Atlantic, and has earned our widespread respect.","parent_excerpt":"I feel certain that your career and achievements will benefit Canada as well as the world.","explanation":"Both invoke the new prime minister's established career and achievements as the basis for confidence in his leadership."},{"child_excerpt":"I feel confident you will bring to your new task the same vision, determination and sympathetic understanding you have shown in the past.","parent_excerpt":"I feel certain that your career and achievements will benefit Canada as well as the world.","explanation":"The child elaborates the parent's confidence formula by connecting past qualities and achievements to future performance."},{"child_excerpt":"let me wish you every success in carrying out the great responsibilities which now devolve upon you as Prime Minister.","parent_excerpt":"I wish you all success in the great responsibility which you have accepted.","explanation":"This is a distinctive close verbal parallel combining a wish for success with the great responsibility of newly assumed national leadership."}]}
